hero.headline: I design interfaces people *enjoy* using — and build them, too.
hero.lead: UI/UX designer & front-end developer turning research and rough ideas into clear, accessible, fast products. From first sketch in Figma to production code.

about.heading: Designer by training, developer by curiosity.
paragraphs: I'm Osama, a UI/UX designer and front-end developer based in Your City. I care about the whole journey: understanding users, mapping flows, crafting pixel-level UI, and shipping it as clean, responsive code.
My process is simple — listen, prototype early, test with real people, and iterate until the interface feels obvious.

contact.heading: Let's build something great together.
contact.text: Have a project, a role, or just a question? My inbox is always open — I usually reply within a day.
